source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.1, data build 995, released 2026-10-16

data.summary:
This model's [transport capacity](vsdata:core-rule/transport-capacity) is 6 models, from these units only: **YVRAINE**, **THE VISARCH**, **YNNARI ARCHON**, **YNNARI SUCCUBUS**, **YNNARI INCUBI**, **YNNARI KABALITE WARRIORS** and **YNNARI WYCHES**.

Before the battle, as [Declare Battle Formations](vsdata:core-rule/combat-patrol.declare-battle-formations) begins, you can pick a **YNNARI KABALITE WARRIORS** or **YNNARI WYCHES** unit of yours that has not been split already, and split it into 2 units as equal in size as possible, noting which models form each. Then:

- one of the 2 units must begin the battle embarked in this **TRANSPORT**
- the other unit can begin the battle embarked in another **TRANSPORT**, or be deployed on its own

splitUnit.when: start of the Declare Battle Formations step

otherMay: be deployed as a separate unit
